d: Paper straws may not be as environmentally friendly as we think. A South Korean study suggests conventional plastic straws had a lower environmental impact in 10 of 16 categories examined. From paper straws and cotton tote bags to biodegradable plastics and electric cars, this story explores the hidden environmental costs behind products marketed as green alternatives. Even reusable bags may need thousands of uses to offset their production impact. The takeaway? Sustainability is about more than appearances or good intentions.
